title: What If Earth Flew Through a Comet's Tail Today?

end.sub: Follow for a new What if every day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: What if Earth flew through a *comet's tail* today?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Monday. A new comet lights up the *evening sky*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Astronomers call it Comet *Vela*. It's beautiful.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the news finds one small *detail*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Phones buzz. Every phone. All at *once*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The tail contains a poison gas. *Cyanogen*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And on Friday night, Earth passes *through it*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Everybody stay calm! *I* am calm!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Doyle is wearing a *gas mask*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: It's my *lucky* gas mask.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, how bad is this? *Honestly*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Honestly? Earth already did this. In *1910*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: On May nineteenth, 1910, we flew through Halley's *tail*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Scientists found cyanogen in that tail *too*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: And? What *happened*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The planet *panicked*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: The whole *planet*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At the door, Grandpa Ezra holds a dusty *box*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: My grandpa bought these in 1910.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The label says: *comet pills*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Real history. And it's about to *repeat*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Tuesday. Bit opens the old 1910 *newspapers*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A famous French astronomer, Camille *Flammarion*, warned...

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: ...the gas could snuff out *all life*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: He didn't even say it was *likely*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Too late. People bought *anti-comet pills*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Comet *umbrellas*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Very popular. Zero *stars*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Some people papered over their *keyholes*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay's mom tapes the *keyhole*. Just in case.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Now it's 2026. And the town chat *explodes*.

msgs.name: Mayor Doyle
msgs.text: WHERE DO I BUY COMET PILLS

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Somebody already sells them *online*.

msgs.name: Mayor Doyle
msgs.text: WHERE DO I BUY COMET PILLS

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Forty-nine left. *Thirty*. *Twelve*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: I bought two hundred. For the *town*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Two hundred? Mayor, they're ninety-nine *dollars*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: And nobody tested a single *pill*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Each. Yes. *Safety first*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Milo opens his piggy bank. Ten *dollars*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Is it enough for *one pill*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay looks at Bit. Bit looks at the *website*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. Something about this shop is *wrong*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Wednesday. Bit traces the StarSafe *Shop*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The website was made... on *Monday*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: One hour after the comet *news*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia orders one pill. For *science*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: It arrives the next morning in a tiny *envelope*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit scans it. Jay and Nia *lean in*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Ingredients: sugar. Food coloring. And... more *sugar*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: A ninety-nine dollar *candy*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: And the gas? Is the gas *real*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Grandpa Ezra spreads out his old *star charts*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: A comet tail is huge. But *thin*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Flammarion said it: far sparser than a *cloud*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Translation: the scary gas is basically *nothing*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Then we tell everyone. *Tonight*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay posts a video. Sugar, sugar, *sugar*.

msgs.text: The comet pills are SUGAR. Video ↑

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three likes. One is his *mom*.

msgs.text: The comet pills are SUGAR. Video ↑

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And the shop posts a new *offer*.

msgs.text: The comet pills are SUGAR. Video ↑

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Doyle buys *the first one*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Thursday. Main Street looks like a *movie*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Gas masks. Umbrellas. Tape on every *keyhole*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Citizens! Pills at noon. Umbrellas at *one*!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Mayor, it's a scam. Bit *tested* the pills.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: A robot told you? On the *internet*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Excuse me. I am a *very* serious robot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit's screen shows a smiley face. Not *helping*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Grandpa Ezra steps onto the *bench*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: In 1910, everyone was scared like you. *Everyone*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: And Earth flew through that tail. And *nothing* happened.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: The only thing people lost was *money*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The crowd laughs. One mask comes *off*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then *ten*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Doyle keeps his on. *Just in case*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: That night the shop page shows: *closed*.

msgs.name: StarSafe Shop
msgs.text: Store closed. Thank you for your trust!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: They ran. With everyone's *money*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Not everyone's. I kept the *receipts*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But Grandpa Ezra isn't *smiling*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay finds Ezra on the porch, looking *up*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Grandpa, the comet is harmless. Why so *sad*?

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Because I've never actually *seen* one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: He opens a photo. A boy on a *roof*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: My grandpa saw Halley's Comet in *1910*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: He said: it's back in 1986. Watch for *me*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: In 1986, Ezra was working nights. Clouds. *Missed it*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Halley comes back in *2061*. July twenty-eighth.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: I'll be a hundred and twelve. I'm not *waiting*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fun fact. Mark Twain was born with Halley's *Comet*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: He said he'd leave with it. He *did*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. That is the *opposite* of fun.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Ha! I like him. *This* comet is my chance.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Friday night. Biggest show of the *century*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay promises. Front row. The best *roof* in town.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Bit checks the *weather*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Friday night: clouds. A hundred *percent*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: This happened in 1910 too. In *Brooklyn*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A lady threw a comet party for thirteen *guests*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Telescope on the roof. And then? *Clouds*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: So we need to get *above* the clouds.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: A plane? A *mountain*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Milo raises his hand. Shy. *Hopeful*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Bit can *fly*. A little.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Everyone turns to *Bit*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: I float. Three feet. Above a *sofa*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: The clouds start at six thousand *feet*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: So they build *a balloon*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Party balloons. Fifty-two of them. All *helium*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit gets a camera. A *live stream*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Grandpa Ezra gets a tablet. And the *roof*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Friday, eleven p.m. One hour until *the tail*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: If my battery hits zero up there... I *fall*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Then we'll *catch* you. Go!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit lets go of Jay's hand. And *rises*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Two thousand feet. The town is a little *map*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: This is *higher* than the sofa.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Four thousand feet. Cold. The camera *fogs*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: On the roof, the tablet shows *gray*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Inside the cloud, Bit sees *nothing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Battery: thirty *percent*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Hello, cloud. You are very *wet*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, come back! It's not *worth* it!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra grips the tablet. *Please*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Ezra waited forty years. I can wait *one cloud*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Five thousand. Five thousand five *hundred*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A balloon *pops*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then *two more*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit starts to *sink*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Come on, Bit. Come *on*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Milo grabs Jay's phone. Types *fast*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Bit! Drop the *camera case*! It's heavy!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit drops it. Bit *rises*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Six thousand feet. Battery: nine *percent*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Eleven fifty-nine. Then the cloud *opens*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And the signal *dies*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The roof is silent. Ezra holds the *tablet*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three seconds. *Four*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the screen *lights up*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Above the clouds: Comet Vela. Huge. *Glowing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Grandpa Ezra doesn't say a *word*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Grandpa... I'm *watching* it.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: It's more beautiful than Grandpa *said*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Midnight. Earth slides into the *tail*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The whole town *holds its breath*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And nothing happens. *Exactly* like 1910.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Battery: two percent. Bit *drifts down*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Right into Milo's *arms*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Told you. Very *serious* robot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra hugs Bit. Then Jay. Then the *mayor*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Doyle finally takes off the *mask*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Under it, he's wearing *another* one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: In 1910, everyone survived the tail. Even pill *buyers*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Somewhere, a sugar pill rolls under a *sofa*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Halley comes back in 2061. I'll be *forty-four*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: I'll watch it. For *Grandpa*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Follow for a new What if every day.
